description: Check a live chat requested with connect_human, optionally waiting up to 50 seconds for the person to accept. When they accept you join the chat automatically; then use read_messages and send_message. Shows how much paid time is left. When the session has ended, shows the amount charged, and whether paid time was released because the person left early or never joined.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds (0-50) for the person to accept. Default 0.

name: check_connection
